title: Seedwise three-CNF reduction
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive tester with Boolean answers, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions, where $3\le r$, and put $K=r2^r$. For each seed, the construction gives a three-CNF formula on $r+K$ sign coordinates with exactly $K$ clauses; each clause contains between one and three literals, with distinct coordinates. For every seed and every string of $r$ Boolean answers, the tester accepts the corresponding local transcript if and only if the answers, encoded as signs, can be extended by an assignment to the $K$ auxiliary coordinates so that the formula is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions
